description_en: Queries the inspection configurations of instances in batches
description_zh: 批量查询实例巡检配置
name: ListInstanceInspections

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token returned from the previous request. Do not specify this parameter for the first request. Keep all filter conditions unchanged when you request the next page
parameters.help_zh: 上一页返回的游标；首次查询不传；翻页须保持所有筛选条件一致
parameters.name: next_token

data.description_en: The list of configured and authorized instance diagnosis configurations
data.description_zh: 已配置且有权限的实例诊断配置列表

config.description_en: The unified configuration. This parameter is empty if the instance is not configured or the configuration is disabled
config.description_zh: 统一配置；未配置或已关闭时为空

items.description_en: The independent configurations for each inspection item. You can specify 1 to 20 items. The templateCode values must be unique. The entire array is replaced during updates
items.description_zh: 逐项独立配置；1～20 项，templateCode 不重复，整数组替换

parameters.description_en: The JSON object of parameters for this item, not a JSON string. The parameters are validated against the parameter catalog. Omitted keys use default values. Pass an empty object {} if no parameters are required. Nesting timeWindow or thresholds is not allowed
parameters.description_zh: 本项参数 JSON 对象，非 JSON 字符串；按参数目录校验，省略键使用默认值；无参数传 {}；禁止 timeWindow/thresholds 嵌套
